articles.title: Why stealing billions from a crypto exchange can be harder to stop than a bank theft
articles.snippet: The $6.3 billion Binance breach has revived a debate over whether crypto exchanges are less secure than banks or simply harder to protect once hackers get inside.

articles.title: What is EIP-7702? The Ethereum Upgrade Behind the $6.4B Binance Hack
articles.snippet: EIP-7702 lets ordinary Ethereum wallets run smart contract code, enabling batched and sponsored transactions. Here's how it works.
